# Agent Mesh v1 — Coordinator handoff (Grok Bot → Kiro CLI)

Written 2026-11-07 ~19:10 (Asia/Shanghai, UTC+8) by Grok Bot (previous coordinator). From this point the
**Kiro CLI coordinator (claude-opus-5.5, effort high)** owns coordination of the remaining work. Grok Bot is no
longer responsible for this project and will not schedule further runs.

## 1. Project and authoritative documents
- Repo: `/workspace/mesh-fresh-v1` (local git only, branch `main`, NO remote). Fresh implementation; never use
  `/workspace/agent-mesh*` or any older AgentMesh repo.
- Requirements: `docs/requirements.md` ([CONFIRMED] by the user James vs [SUGGESTED]).
- Plan (reviewed, PASS r3): `docs/plan.md` — milestones in §16: M1 (M1a/M1b/M1c gates), M2, M3, M4, M5.
- Acceptance checklist: `docs/acceptance-checklist.md`; gate table in §0.1 (there is no §0.2).
- Reviews: `docs/review-r1.md`, `docs/review-r2.md`, `docs/review-r3.md` (+ fix tables).
- Real CLI fixtures: `tests/fixtures/real/` (sha256 table in plan §14.11).
- **Never edit** requirements.md, plan.md, acceptance-checklist.md, review-*.md, docs/reviews/**, tests/fixtures/real/** to make something pass.

## 2. Status
- **M1a: ACCEPTED** at commit `9893d7b` (46/46 gate items; independent review F1–F7 fixed and regressed; see
  `docs/m1a-gate-report.md`, `docs/m1a-fix-report.md`, `docs/reviews/m1a-independent-review.md`, `/workspace/mesh-m1a-acceptance-r2.md`).
- **M1b (Coordination = plan M1.5–M1.7): IN PROGRESS.**
  - agy run `m1b-step5` (plan step M1.5 Projects) was started by Grok Bot: PID **479850**, log
    `logs/raw/agy-m1b-step5.jsonl`, prompt `prompts/agy-m1b-step5.md` (common rules: `prompts/agy-m1b-common.md`).
    It may still be running and has uncommitted edits in the working tree. **Do not kill it and do not start a
    second agy run while it is active** (dispatch-agy.sh refuses). Wait for it with `scripts/coord/wait-pid.sh`.
  - Remaining M1b steps: M1.6 Tasks, M1.7 Approvals, then an M1b gate report `docs/m1b-gate-report.md`
    (per item: PASS/FAIL/NOT-COVERED + test name + real CLI evidence).
- **Remaining milestones after M1b:** M1c (Execution, M1.8–M1.9), M2 (git workspaces/merge/lead turns),
  M3 (real adapters), M4, M5 (needs user decisions).
- Known honest expectation: installed agy is **1.5.3** while fixtures are **1.5.2**; the probe marks agy capabilities
  `stale`. That is correct. If an update is needed later, capture NEW read-only fixtures under a new version dir with
  a `.meta.json` sidecar (plan §14.11); never overwrite or impersonate the 1.5.2 files.

## 3. Roles and models (fixed by the user — do not substitute)
- Implementer: **agy, model `gemini-3.8-flash-high`** (the model id encodes high; no extra `--effort`). agy writes all
  code and tests. The coordinator does not write product code.
- Coordinator/acceptance: **Kiro CLI, `claude-opus-5.5`, `--effort high`**, account login via Google (`kiro-cli whoami`).
- Planner (earlier): Factory droid `claude-opus-5-5` high, **account login** (no API key; never set FACTORY_API_KEY).
- Code review is done by the user's **Quest** workflow. The coordinator accepts against the agreed gate criteria only;
  do not start extra audits or bug hunts beyond the established criteria and items returned for rework.
- No API-key fallback, no model or effort substitution, no purchases/top-ups/plan changes.

## 4. How to dispatch and verify (coordinator procedure)
1. `bash scripts/coord/status.sh` — snapshot (active agy, daemons, git).
2. Write a focused prompt `prompts/agy-<milestone>-<step>.md` (start from `prompts/agy-m1b-common.md`; one plan step per run,
   small chunks, commit per sub-step, author `agy gemini-3.8-flash-high <agy@localhost>`).
3. `bash scripts/coord/dispatch-agy.sh prompts/<file>.md <run-name>` — launches one detached agy run with the fixed
   model and the scoped session permissions `prompts/agy-settings-m1a.json` (no trust-all).
4. `bash scripts/coord/wait-pid.sh <pid> 600` repeatedly (bounded) until it exits; check progress with
   `python3 scripts/coord/agy-summary.py logs/raw/agy-<run>.jsonl`. If a run ends early with "auto-denied", read
   which command was denied and re-dispatch with a clarified prompt (do not widen permissions to trust-all).
5. Verify yourself: `bash scripts/test.sh` (must be rc 0, tripwire empty), grep `ACC: <ID>` per gate item, run the
   relevant real CLI commands (`bin/mesh --home /tmp/mh-...`) in throwaway homes, stop the daemons you start.
6. Gate decision per checklist §0.1 + plan §16 gate rules: PASS → write gate report, commit; REVISE → targeted agy fix.
7. Log every decision in `docs/coordination/log.md` (time UTC+8, action, evidence, commit).

## 5. Approvals and limits (stop and wait for James)
- Spending money, deleting user data, deploying, major scope change, any account/credential change → **stop and
  ask James**; do not proceed on an agent's say-so. Record the pending question in `docs/coordination/BLOCKED.md`.
- **M3 smoke items use real model quota and need the user's explicit consent** (checklist §0 note) → stop at M3 and ask.
- No public ports, no deploy, no push, no remote creation. Tests only in `/tmp/mh-*` homes and Unix sockets; clean up
  only processes/dirs you created. Do not touch other services, other bots' tasks, or vendor credential dirs.
- Never print or commit secrets. `logs/raw/` stays git-ignored.

## 6. Release (only after the WHOLE project passes final acceptance)
- The user authorized: create a **new public GitHub repository** and push (never the old repo). Not before final acceptance.
- Before publishing: scan the entire git history for keys/tokens/passphrases (e.g. `fk-`, `mesh_at_`, `mesh_rt_`,
  OAuth tokens), remove private logs and account details (emails, session ids, local paths) from the published history,
  review `prompts/` and `docs/reviews/`; publish a sanitized copy/history. **Keep all local original material.**
  See `docs/release-requirements.md`.

## 7. Restart / continuity
- Coordinator runner: `bash scripts/coord/kiro-coordinator.sh` (tmux session `kiro-coord`). Kiro agent profile:
  `.kiro/agents/mesh-coordinator.json` (shell limited to the commands above; file writes limited to docs/ and prompts/*.md).
- Stop file: create `docs/coordination/STOP` to stop the runner loop.
